defects.description: The word 'value' (and 'defaults') is mistranslated as 'замечание' (remark/note) instead of 'значение'.
The word 'defaults' is mistranslated as 'замечания по умолчанию'.

Complete mistranslation of 'explicitly set, never inferred'. The translation 'явно задача, никогда не выводится' is nonsensical in this context; 'inferred' refers to logical derivation, not outputting data.
